Membership

$24 a month carries the business

The Movement is a lovely product, but at $24 a month every new dollar needs a lot of new members. There’s nothing in your journey that earns more from the women who love your work most.

Free tools

The freebies don’t lead anywhere live

Soul Stroll and the free meditations collect emails, then it’s up to an inbox to do the rest. Nobody gets to spend an hour with you live before deciding to join.

High ticket

No door for the women who want more of you

Your coaching page says “coming soon” and there’s no application. The women who would happily invest in working with you closely have nowhere to raise their hand.

Women in 155+ countries already practise with you. There’s no free live hour yet where they meet you, join The Movement, or ask to go deeper.

My recommendation

A free masterclass on returning to yourself, with The Movement on the thank-you page

You already have a low-ticket product, so the masterclass itself should be free. It’s a mindset class built around your daily practice: one hour on making ten minutes a day just for you. The Movement earns from day one and helps pay for the ads, and the replay page invites the right women to apply for your coaching.

Monetises the 95%

A free hour with you is the easiest yes there is. Everyone who registers sees The Movement on the thank-you page, right when they’re most inspired to start, and that revenue covers the ad spend.

Shows you who’s qualified

The women who stay to the end and apply from the replay page are raising their hand. A short application tells you who wants personal guidance before anyone gets on a call.

Opens your coaching properly

Instead of a “coming soon” page, your coaching gets a front door that fills itself every month, from women who have already practised with you live.

The 95%*

Inspired, not ready for more yet

They join the free masterclass, many start The Movement, and some pick up Mantras in Motion. Your classes and emails keep them practising with you until they’re ready.

The qualified 5%

Ready for personal guidance now

They stay to the end and apply from the replay page. A few questions (what they want support with, timing, readiness to invest) sort them before a short call about your coaching.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

Who it’s for

For the women who look after everyone, and want some time back for themselves

  • You take care of everyone else and would love something that’s just for you.
  • You’ve started routines before, and life got in the way.

Meet your host

Hi, I’m Erin

I’m a former professional dancer, a certified life coach and meditation teacher, and the author of Mantras in Motion, published by Hay House. For more than 15 years I’ve been building a way of combining movement, mindfulness and personal growth, and in 2019 I launched The Movement so women anywhere could practise with me.

You may have seen me on The Today Show or the Rachael Ray Show. This masterclass is my way of sharing the practice at the heart of everything I teach, for free.
